MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.description: Modifier stacking uses TWO separate pools that never cross-apply. Prep tasks use condition x RRP x access x vent x tg. Coating tasks use QT x access x vent x tg. Condition and RRP NEVER apply to coating tasks. QT NEVER applies to prep tasks.
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_prep: POOR(2.0) x RRP(2.0) x scaffold(1.60) x vented(1.15) x tg_board(1.20) = 8.83x — extreme theoretical, unrealistic combination
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_prep: FAIR(1.5) x no_RRP(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x vented(1.15) x solid_panel(1.0) = 2.33x — within cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.worst_case_coating: QT4(1.30) x scaffold(1.60) x vented(1.15) x tg_board(1.20) = 2.87x — within 4.0x cap
MODIFIER_STACKING_WARNING.realistic_worst_coating: QT3(1.0) x ladder(1.35) x vented(1.15) x solid_panel(1.0) = 1.55x — comfortable

prep_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (condition x rrp x access x vent x tg)

coating_tasks.formula: effective_rate = base_rate / (qt x access x vent x tg)

fixed_tasks.note: Assessment fixed tasks, equipment setup/cleanup, RRP containment, customer walkthrough — no modifiers applied.

soffit_surface_input_group.description: Rate per SF applies to net soffit field area from PaintScope. Engine divides SF by rate to calculate hours. ALL base rates in this spec already include overhead work penalty (~25-35% reduction from vertical baselines). Do NOT apply FAC_SFRP_OVERHEAD as a separate stacking modifier. RP rates calibrated from NC sibling (SF_SOFFIT_EXT_NC_v1) with RP-specific adjustments.

task_production_rates._note: Protection setup, fixture masking, vent masking, equipment staging

task_production_rates.name: Landscape Ground Protection Below Soffit
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_LANDSCAPE_PROTECT (NC 200 SF/hr). Ground-level task — no overhead penalty. Deploy plastic sheeting and tarps over landscape below soffit work zone. ~18 sec per SF. RP emphasis: catches scraping debris in addition to drips. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

task_production_rates.name: Hardscape Walkway Protection Below Soffit
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_HARDSCAPE_PROTECT (NC 250 SF/hr). Ground-level task. Lay drop cloths and plastic on flat walkway/patio surfaces. ~14 sec per SF. Upgrades to full_cover for spray or RRP.

task_production_rates.name: Soffit Light Fixture Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FIXTURE_MASK (NC 10 EA/hr). Bag and tape soffit-mounted fixtures overhead — recessed lights, porch fixtures. ~6 min per fixture. Overhead access adds time for taping and bagging above head.

task_production_rates.name: Fascia Edge Masking
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_FASCIA_MASK. NC used SF proxy (500 SF/hr); RP uses LF for direct measurement of fascia-soffit junction tape line. ~30 sec per LF overhead. Tape + 12-inch masking film. In RP, fascia is almost always already finished — masking is MANDATORY regardless of application method.

task_production_rates.name: Mask Soffit Vent Openings (Vented Soffit Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Apply tape or foam plugs to individual soffit vent openings before brush_roll application. Rate per SF of soffit field (proxy for vent count). ~12 sec per SF equivalent. Prevents further paint accumulation in vents from RP coating (FM-006). Vented soffit + brush_roll only.

task_production_rates.name: Brush/Roll Equipment Setup for Overhead Work
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_BRUSH (NC 25 min). Per-session FIXED time. Stage brushes, rollers, trays, extension poles, ladders/scaffold per access_type. No modifiers on FIXED setup tasks.

task_production_rates.name: Spray Equipment Setup for Overhead Work
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_EQUIPMENT_SETUP_SPRAY (NC 50 min). Per-session FIXED time. Configure airless sprayer with 413-515 tip for overhead. NON-VENTED SOFFIT ONLY. No modifiers on FIXED setup tasks.

task_production_rates._note: RP-specific condition assessment. All RP_NEW. FIXED or SF-based.

task_production_rates.name: Visual Condition Inspection — All Soffit Surfaces

QT2.notes: Standard visual scan overhead, document visible defects.

QT3.notes: Thorough scan with work light overhead, document all defect areas, per-elevation assessment.

QT4.notes: Systematic scan with raking light overhead, photograph all defects, per-panel assessment.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Overhead visual condition assessment. Calibrated from exterior window RP TSK_XWRP_ASSESS_CONDITION pattern, scaled for overhead field surface (SF-based vs EA). QT2: ~6 sec/SF quick scan. QT3: ~9 sec/SF thorough scan. QT4: ~14 sec/SF systematic scan. Access modifier applies (inspection at height is slower). No condition or RRP modifiers — assessment precedes condition classification.

task_production_rates.name: Adhesion Test (ASTM D3359 Cross-Hatch Tape Test)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Cross-hatch tape test per ASTM D3359 at minimum 2 locations per elevation from ladder/scaffold. ~10 min per elevation. Calibrated from TSK_XWRP_ASSESS_ADHESION (5 min/EA window); soffit requires 2 test locations per elevation = ~10 min. Results gate prime module: pass + SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT = skip full prime.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Algae Assessment — Soffit-Specific Priority Check
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Visual scan for mildew/algae from working height overhead. ~4.5 sec per SF. Faster than condition assessment because looking for specific pattern (dark spots/patches, green/yellow growth). Classify extent: spot (<25%), moderate (25-50%), widespread (>50%). Soffit is #1 exterior surface for mildew growth. Access modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Moisture Check — Panel Joints, Roof Penetrations
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-elevation FIXED time. Moisture meter readings at panel joints, near roof penetrations, and at water staining locations from ladder. ~10 min per elevation. Calibrated from TSK_XWRP_ASSESS_MOISTURE (4 min/EA window); soffit has 4-6 test points per elevation. Wood soffit only. MC >15% = STOP WORK for coating.

task_production_rates.name: Caulk Condition Assessment — Panel Joints and Trim Junctions
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Inspect existing caulk at soffit panel-to-panel joints, soffit-to-fascia, soffit-to-frieze junctions overhead. ~6 sec per SF equivalent. Classify: intact (paint over), cracked (repair), fully failed (full re-caulk). Results drive caulk repair scope in prep module. Access modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: Vent Opening Condition Check (Vented Soffit Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Inspect vent openings for paint clogging from prior brush_roll applications. ~4.5 sec per SF equivalent. Fast visual assessment from working height. Classify: clear, partially clogged, heavily clogged. Vented soffit only. Access modifier applies.

task_production_rates._note: Condition-driven prep. Prep pool modifiers: condition x RRP x access x vent x tg.

task_production_rates.name: Low-Pressure Wash Soffit Surface (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_WASH_LOW_PRESSURE. NC used SF-based rate (350 SF/hr); RP uses per-elevation FIXED time (30 min midpoint). Low-pressure wash 500-800 PSI max, fan tip, mildew-removal detergent. HIGH-PRESSURE POWER WASHING IS PROHIBITED on soffit. Per-elevation FIXED — covers all soffit on that elevation. Cross-spec deduplication rule U-003: skip if wash already performed by another spec on same elevation. No modifiers on FIXED per-elevation tasks.

task_production_rates.name: Mildew/Algae Biocide Treatment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Apply biocide/mildewcide solution to mildew/algae-affected soffit areas overhead. ~18 sec per SF. Scrub with soft brush to loosen dead growth. Rinse. Allow dry. Calibrated from TSK_XWRP_MILDEW_TREAT (10 min/EA window ~ 100-120 SF/hr of affected area); soffit field is larger contiguous surface = faster per-SF than window detail work. Soffit is #1 exterior surface for mildew growth. Condition modifier applies (FAIR/POOR have more extensive growth). No RRP modifier — biocide is cleaning, not paint disturbance.

task_production_rates.name: Chalk Remediation (Pre-Treatment for Chalk-Binding Primer)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Chemical chalk remover on stubborn chalking areas after wash, verify with white cloth test. ~14 sec per SF. Calibrated from TSK_XWRP_CHALK_REMEDIATION (12 min/EA medium window ~ 200-250 SF/hr scaled to field surface). No RRP modifier — chalk remediation is cleaning, not paint disturbance. SS_EXT_CHALKING only.

task_production_rates.name: Scrape Failing Paint and Feather Edges — Overhead

QT2.notes: Remove all failing paint, feather edges — no visible ridge at 10 ft. ~45 sec/SF.

QT3.notes: Comprehensive scrape + feathering — no visible ridge at 6 ft. ~55 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Thorough scrape + near-invisible feathering — smooth to touch at arm's length. ~72 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Overhead scraping is the SLOWEST exterior prep task per SF — gravity works against tool stroke and debris falls on painter. Rates calibrated from exterior window RP TSK_XWRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER (25 min/EA medium window ~= 60-70 SF/hr for field surface at QT3). Overhead penalty already baked into base rates (vertical scraping baseline: 100-120 SF/hr). Condition modifier: FAIR = moderate scraping (15-30% of surface), POOR = heavy scraping (40-60%+). RRP 2.0x for wet scraping methods. T&G joints add complexity (T&G modifier 1.20x).

task_production_rates.name: Degloss/Scuff Existing Paint — Overhead

QT2.notes: Key areas deglossed for adhesion. ~28 sec/SF.

QT3.notes: Full surface degloss — chemical or mechanical on all accessible surfaces overhead. ~33 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Complete degloss with adhesion verification. T&G grooves hand-deglossed. ~42 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_SAND_PREP_WOOD (NC 150 SF/hr). RP degloss/scuff on existing paint is ~75% of NC bare wood sanding time — existing paint provides uniform surface vs NC bare wood mill glaze. QT3 baseline: 110 SF/hr (NC wood sand was 150 SF/hr; RP ~73%). Chemical degloss preferred for T&G grooves. Vent and T&G modifiers apply. Skip for SS_EXT_PEELING (full scrape) and SS_EXT_CHALKING (chalk remediation path).

task_production_rates.name: Assess and Repair Failed Caulk — Panel Joints and Trim Junctions

QT2.notes: Replace visibly failed sections — cracked or separated joints. ~18 sec/SF.

QT3.notes: Comprehensive assessment, replace all suspect and failed joints, smooth tool. ~24 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Replace all joints not in perfect condition, precision tooled bead overhead. ~36 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Rate per SF of soffit field (proxy for joint density). Calibrated from NC TSK_SFIT_CAULK_JOINTS (55 LF/hr) and TSK_XWRP_CAULK_ASSESS_REPAIR (8 min/EA at QT3). RP rates lower than NC because only failed joints are replaced (not all joints). GOOD condition ≈ near-zero repair scope. FAIR/POOR = increasing joint failure. Caulk AFTER primer in field execution (COMPAT-SFIT-009).

task_production_rates.name: Clean Paint-Clogged Vent Openings (Vented Soffit Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Wire brush or pick to clean partially clogged soffit vent openings overhead. Rate per SF of soffit field (proxy for vent density). ~14 sec per SF equivalent. Triggered by assessment finding partial clogging. Vented soffit only. No condition or RRP modifiers — vent cleaning is mechanical, not paint-surface work.

task_production_rates.name: Scuff-Sand Exposed Fiber Cement Areas
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_SAND_PREP_FC (NC 175 SF/hr). Same rate — exposed bare FC scuff-sand is identical physical action. RP targets exposed areas only (spot task, not full surface), but per-SF rate is unchanged. 150 grit scuff for mechanical adhesion profile before alkali-resistant spot primer. Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Scuff-Sand Exposed Vinyl Areas
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_SAND_PREP_VINYL (NC 175 SF/hr). Same rate — exposed bare vinyl scuff-sand is identical physical action. RP targets exposed areas only (spot task). 220 grit scuff for bonding primer adhesion. Without scuff-sanding, bonding primer alone is insufficient — coating peels in sheets (RISK-SFIT-007). Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Prep Dust Cleanup — Overhead
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_DUST_CLEANUP (NC 400 SF/hr). Tack cloth dust removal from soffit surface overhead. ~9 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in. Much dust falls away due to gravity, but residual particles must be removed for adhesion. Access modifier applies. No condition or RRP modifiers — dust cleanup is the same regardless of condition.

task_production_rates._note: State-driven primer + substrate-specific spot primer. Coating pool modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: State-Driven Primer — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 120 SF/hr). Same rate — brush/roll primer application overhead is identical physical action regardless of primer product. NC uses acrylic primer; RP uses state-driven primer (chalk-binding for SS_EXT_CHALKING, acrylic stain-block for SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING). ~30 sec per SF. Default for all vented soffits. Vent complexity and T&G modifiers apply. Skip for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT when adhesion verified.

task_production_rates.name: State-Driven Primer — Spray Overhead Application (Non-Vented Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_PRIME_SPRAY (NC 250 SF/hr). Same rate — spray primer application overhead is identical physical action. ~14 sec per SF. NON-VENTED SOFFIT ONLY — spray on vented drives paint into attic (FM-001). No vent or T&G modifiers — spray is only on non-vented soffit. Skip for SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT when adhesion verified.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Exposed Fiber Cement with Alkali-Resistant Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_PRIME_ALKALI_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 100 SF/hr). Same per-SF rate — alkali-resistant primer on exposed bare FC is identical physical action. RP targets exposed areas only (spot priming), but rate per SF of area treated is unchanged. ~36 sec per SF. Brush only — spot application too small for spray. Applied IN ADDITION to general state-driven prime.

task_production_rates.name: Spot Prime Exposed Vinyl with Bonding Primer
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_PRIME_VINYL_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 110 SF/hr). Same per-SF rate — bonding primer on exposed bare vinyl is identical physical action. RP targets exposed areas only (spot priming). ~33 sec per SF. Brush only — spot application too small for spray. Recoat within 1 week (RISK-SFIT-008).

task_production_rates._note: Between-coat inspection and maintenance. DIRECT transfer from NC. Coating pool modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Inspection — Overhead

QT3.notes: Quick scan from ladder for obvious defects — runs, sags, holidays, drips. ~3.6 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Systematic inspection with raking light overhead. Mark all visible defects. Check T&G grooves. ~7.2 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_INSPECT_COAT (NC QT3: 1000, QT4: 500 SF/hr). Identical process once surface is primed and first-coated. Overhead penalty baked in. QT3/QT4 only — QT2 is single coat.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Light Sand — QT4 Only
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_SAND_INTERCOAT (NC 175 SF/hr). 220 grit light scuff between finish coats overhead. ~20 sec per SF. QT4 only. T&G joints add complexity (1.20x modifier). Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Interstage Touch-Up

QT3.notes: Fix obvious defects only overhead. ~2.4 sec/SF.

QT4.notes: Fix all found defects overhead. Blend repairs. ~5.1 sec/SF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_TOUCHUP_REPAIR (NC QT3: 1500, QT4: 700 SF/hr). Identical brush touch-up process overhead. Overhead penalty baked in. QT3/QT4 only.

task_production_rates.name: Intercoat Dust Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_DUST_INTERCOAT (NC 400 SF/hr). Tack cloth dust removal after intercoat sanding overhead. ~9 sec per SF. QT4 only (paired with TSK_SFRP_SAND_INTERCOAT). Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates._note: Coat 1 and Coat 2 application. DIRECT transfers from NC. Coating pool modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In at Fascia/Frieze Junctions — Coat 1

QT2.notes: Clean enough line at junctions overhead. Quick brush work. ~30 sec/LF.

QT3.notes: Straight, consistent cut-in line overhead. Careful brush control. ~40 sec/LF.

QT4.notes: Crisp, precise cut-in at 3 ft viewing standard overhead. Deliberate strokes. ~60 sec/LF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_CUTIN_FASCIA_1. NC used SF proxy (QT2: 400, QT3: 300, QT4: 200 SF/hr); RP converts to LF per SOP module UOM. Conversion: NC ~3.3 LF junction per SF (typical soffit geometry). QT3: 300 SF/hr x 0.3 LF/SF ≈ 90 LF/hr. Overhead penalty baked in. Required for both brush_roll and spray methods.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FINISH_1_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 120 SF/hr). Roller with extension pole for open field, brush for T&G grooves overhead. ~30 sec per SF. Overhead penalty baked in. Thin coats required to prevent sag. Default method for ALL vented soffits. Vent and T&G modifiers apply.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 1 — Spray Overhead Application (Non-Vented Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FINISH_1_SPRAY (NC 250 SF/hr). Airless spray finish overhead on non-vented solid panel soffit. ~14 sec per SF. NON-VENTED ONLY (FM-001). Lower pressure and tight fan pattern (413-515 tip). Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: T&G Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 1
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_TG_BRUSH_BACK_1 (NC 150 SF/hr). Brush paint into T&G groove joints overhead while spray coat is wet. ~24 sec per SF. Two-person operation: sprayer leads, brusher follows within 30-60 sec. Rate is for brusher only. Do NOT apply FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS — groove work is already the task's entire purpose.

task_production_rates.name: Cut-In at Fascia/Frieze Junctions — Coat 2

QT3.notes: Straight, consistent cut-in line overhead. Final coat. ~40 sec/LF.

QT4.notes: Crisp, precise cut-in at 3 ft viewing standard overhead. Final appearance coat. ~60 sec/LF.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_CUTIN_FASCIA_2. Same rates as coat 1 per tier. NC used SF proxy; RP converts to LF per SOP module UOM. QT3/QT4 only — QT2 is single coat. Final appearance coat — precision matters.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Brush/Roll Overhead Application
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FINISH_2_BRUSH_ROLL (NC 120 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1. Primed and first-coated surface provides consistent absorption. QT3/QT4 only — QT2 is single coat. Final appearance coat.

task_production_rates.name: Finish Coat 2 — Spray Overhead Application (Non-Vented Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FINISH_2_SPRAY (NC 250 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1. NON-VENTED ONLY. QT3/QT4 only. Final appearance coat.

task_production_rates.name: T&G Groove Brush-Back After Spray — Coat 2
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_TG_BRUSH_BACK_2 (NC 150 SF/hr). Same rate as coat 1. Final coat — all grooves must have full coverage. Do NOT apply FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS.

task_production_rates._note: Final inspection, protection teardown, equipment cleanup, customer walkthrough.

task_production_rates.name: Final Walkthrough Inspection — Overhead

QT2.notes: Ground-level walkthrough. Quick scan for misses and drip marks.

QT3.notes: Ground-level walkthrough at 6-10 ft. Check all elevations. Verify T&G groove coverage.

QT4.notes: Ground-level + ladder. Binoculars for upper soffits. 6 ft viewing standard. Raking light on primary elevations.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FINAL_INSPECT (NC QT2: 1500, QT3: 800, QT4: 350 SF/hr). Identical final inspection process. Drip marks and sag are primary defect patterns to check. Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Final Touch-Up — Overhead

QT2.notes: Fix obvious misses and drip marks overhead.

QT4.notes: Fix every defect overhead. Blend seamlessly at 3 ft.

task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_FINAL_TOUCHUP (NC QT2: 2000, QT3: 1000, QT4: 400 SF/hr). Identical brush touch-up process. Overhead penalty baked in.

task_production_rates.name: Remove Vent Opening Masking (Vented Soffit Only)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Remove tape or foam plugs from soffit vent openings. Rate per SF of soffit field. ~7 sec per SF equivalent. Faster than setup (pull vs apply). Verify openings clear and not paint-sealed. Confirm airflow restored. Vented soffit + brush_roll only.

task_production_rates.name: Protection Material Removal
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_PROTECT_TEARDOWN. NC used SF-based rate (350 SF/hr); RP uses per-project FIXED time (25 min) because protection scope is consistent per project. Remove all landscape tarps, hardscape drop cloths, fascia masking tape/film, fixture bags. Check for tape residue on finished fascia. Ground-level task. No modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Clean Equipment
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: DIRECT transfer from TSK_SFIT_CLEAN_EQUIPMENT (NC 30 min). Clean rollers, brushes, extension poles. Flush airless sprayer if used. Clean tips and filters. Ground-level task. No modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Site Debris Cleanup
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: MODIFIED from TSK_SFIT_SITE_CLEANUP (NC 20 min). RP adds 5 min (25 min total) because overhead RP generates more debris than NC — scraping waste, caulk removal waste, biocide containers, masking materials, foam plugs. No modifiers.

task_production_rates.name: Customer Walkthrough
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: RP_NEW. Per-project FIXED time. Walk soffit areas with homeowner at ground level. Inspect finish quality, verify vent function (vented soffit), confirm coverage and sheen consistency. Provide maintenance recommendations: mildew-resistant paint extends coating life on sheltered soffit surfaces. RP-specific — repaint work requires client sign-off.

task_production_rates._note: Lead-safe RRP module. Shared across all exterior RP specs. Conditional on pre_1978 + lead.

task_production_rates.name: Lead Screening Test (XRF or Swab)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Per-elevation FIXED time. XRF preferred; lead swab test acceptable. Test minimum 2 locations per elevation. Results gate all subsequent RRP tasks and 2.0x prep modifier (FAC_SFRP_RRP). Calibrated from window RP pattern (same protocol).

task_production_rates.name: RRP Exterior Containment Setup (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Per-elevation FIXED time. Install 6-mil poly ground containment extending 10 ft from structure per EPA RRP Rule 40 CFR 745. WIDER than standard wall containment for overhead soffit work — scraping debris spreads further when falling from eave height. Secure edges with weights/stakes. Install warning signage. No modifiers on per-elevation FIXED tasks.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Wet Scraping Method
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Wet-mist surface before scraping to minimize lead dust generation overhead. All scraping debris falls into containment. ~72 sec per SF. Overhead wet scraping is the slowest RRP prep task — gravity + water management + lead-safe protocols. Condition modifier applies (more area to scrape at FAIR/POOR). This task's time is ALREADY captured in the 2.0x RRP modifier on TSK_SFRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER — do NOT double-count. Task exists for explicit RRP documentation and lead-safe work practice tracking.

task_production_rates.name: HEPA Vacuum After Paint Disturbance
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. HEPA vacuum all soffit surfaces after each sanding/scraping disturbance to capture lead-contaminated dust. ~12 sec per SF. Required by EPA RRP Rule after EVERY paint disturbance — not just once. Overhead HEPA vacuuming is awkward. Access modifier applies.

task_production_rates.name: RRP Exterior Containment Teardown (Per Elevation)
task_production_rates.rate_basis_notes: Shared RRP task. Per-elevation FIXED time. Remove containment poly — fold inward to capture debris, bag for lead-safe disposal. Verify cleaning standard per EPA (visual + wet wipe test on hard surfaces, HEPA vacuum on soil). No modifiers on per-elevation FIXED tasks.

QT2.description: Economy tier. Single finish coat. Reduced prep scope. Skip interstage module.
QT2.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks use QT2-specific rates directly. Binary tasks unaffected.

QT3.description: Standard tier. 2 finish coats. Full prep. Standard interstage inspection. Baseline for all rate calibration.
QT3.applies_to: All qt_scaled tasks use QT3 as baseline rate.

QT4.description: Premium tier. 2 finish coats + full intercoat sand 220 grit + systematic raking light inspection + premium materials.
QT4.applies_to: qt_scaled tasks use QT4-specific rates directly. Binary tasks use 1.30x global pace modifier.

FAC_CONDITION_SCALE.name: Condition Scale Modifier
FAC_CONDITION_SCALE.applies_to: Prep tasks only: TSK_SFRP_MILDEW_TREAT, TSK_SFRP_CHALK_REMEDIATION, TSK_SFRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER, TSK_SFRP_DEGLOSS_SCUFF, TSK_SFRP_CAULK_ASSESS_REPAIR, TSK_SFRP_SCUFF_EXPOSED_FC, TSK_SFRP_SCUFF_EXPOSED_VINYL, TSK_RRP_EXT_WET_SCRAPE
FAC_CONDITION_SCALE.never_applies_to: Coating tasks (prime, finish, interstage), assessment tasks, setup/cleanup tasks

FAC_SFRP_RRP.name: RRP Lead-Safe Prep Modifier
FAC_SFRP_RRP.gate: IN_BOOL_PRE_1978_EXT = true AND positive lead test
FAC_SFRP_RRP.applies_to: Prep tasks involving paint disturbance: TSK_SFRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER, TSK_SFRP_DEGLOSS_SCUFF, TSK_SFRP_SCUFF_EXPOSED_FC, TSK_SFRP_SCUFF_EXPOSED_VINYL
FAC_SFRP_RRP.never_applies_to: Assessment, coating, inspection, cleanup, biocide, chalk remediation, wash, caulk, vent clean

FAC_EXT_ACCESS.name: Access Type Modifier
FAC_EXT_ACCESS.note: Soffit baseline rates already include overhead penalty — ladder (1.35x) is the EFFECTIVE baseline for most soffit work (always elevated). Ground applies only to very low eaves. Scaffold and lift stack further for high eaves. Per-elevation attribute.
FAC_EXT_ACCESS.applies_to: All per-SF overhead tasks in both prep and coating pools. Also assessment tasks. NOT applied to FIXED per-elevation/per-project tasks (wash, containment, equipment setup, customer walkthrough) or ground-level protection tasks (landscape/hardscape protect).
FAC_EXT_ACCESS.never_applies_to: FIXED tasks, ground-level protection setup tasks

FAC_SFIT_VENT_COMPLEXITY.name: Vented Soffit Application Penalty
FAC_SFIT_VENT_COMPLEXITY.applies_to: Brush/roll application tasks: TSK_SFRP_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL, TSK_SFRP_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL_1, TSK_SFRP_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL_2, TSK_SFRP_DEGLOSS_SCUFF
FAC_SFIT_VENT_COMPLEXITY.never_applies_to: Spray tasks (spray PROHIBITED on vented — not applicable), T&G brush-back tasks, assessment tasks, FIXED tasks

FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS.name: Tongue-and-Groove Joint Complexity Modifier
FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS.applies_to: Brush/roll application and sand tasks: TSK_SFRP_PRIME_BRUSH_ROLL, TSK_SFRP_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL_1, TSK_SFRP_FINISH_BRUSH_ROLL_2, TSK_SFRP_SAND_INTERCOAT, TSK_SFRP_DEGLOSS_SCUFF, TSK_SFRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER
FAC_SFIT_TG_JOINTS.never_applies_to: T&G brush-back tasks (groove work IS the task — already reflected in base rate), spray tasks, FIXED tasks

FAC_SFRP_OVERHEAD.name: Overhead Work Penalty (BAKED INTO BASE RATES — NOT A STACKING MODIFIER)
FAC_SFRP_OVERHEAD.description: All soffit task base rates already include ~25-35% overhead penalty from vertical baselines. This is NOT applied as a separate stacking modifier. Documented for transparency and rate calibration traceability.
FAC_SFRP_OVERHEAD.example: Vertical finish brush_roll: 150-200 SF/hr → Overhead finish brush_roll: 100-150 SF/hr (NC baseline 120 SF/hr)
